We have search results list of templates. Need to pick the one that matches Friedel-Crafts acylation. Look at first entry reaction_id 23352. Mapped_rxn: '[CH3:1][CH:2](CN1CCCCC1CC1CCCCC1)[C:4]1=[CH:5][C:6](Br)=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH:9]1.[Li]CCCC.CC[O:3]CC>>[CH3:1][C:2](=[O:3])[C:4]1=[CH:5][CH:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH:9]1'

This seems to be acylation of aromatic with bromide (aryl bromide) and some acyl chloride? Reactants: aryl bromide (with Br) and something like CC[O:3]CC (maybe acyl chloride?). Actually CC[O:3]CC is an ester? Not clear.

Second entry reaction_id 1195162: mapped_rxn: 'CCCCNC(=[O:3])[O-].CCCC[NH3+].[CH3:1][C:2]1=[CH:6][CH:7]=[CH:8][CH:9]=[CH:4]1.ClC1=C[CH:5]=CC=C1>>[CH3:1][C:2](=[O:3])[C:4]1=[CH:5][CH:6]=[CH:7][CH:8]=[CH:9]1'

This looks like acyl chloride (Cl attached to aromatic) reacting with something else? Actually reactants include CCCCNC(=[O:3])[O-] (maybe carboxylate) and Clc1... (aryl chloride). Not typical.

Third entry reaction_id 345610: mapped_rxn includes aryl bromide and nitrile etc.

We need template that when applied to product (acetophenone) gives aryl halide and acyl chloride. The first template seems plausible: product is acetophenone (CH3-CO-Ph). Reactants: aryl bromide (Br-Ph) and CC[O:3]CC (maybe acyl chloride? Actually CC[O:3]CC is an ester, not acyl chloride). Might be not correct.

Second template: reactants: CCCCNC(=[O:3])[O-] (carboxylate) and Clc1... (aryl chloride). That yields product acetophenone. That seems like Friedel-Crafts acylation using acyl chloride (aryl chloride) and maybe a carboxylate? Not exactly.

But we need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The search result includes 'reaction_id' as integer. That likely is template_id? The problem statement: return template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). So we can use reaction_id as template_id.

Which template is correct? The forward reaction: aryl halide + acyl chloride -> aryl ketone + halide (leaves). In retrosynthesis, we break C-C bond formed and break C-Cl bond of acyl chloride? Actually product has C=O attached to aromatic; the acyl chloride provides carbonyl carbon and Cl leaves. So template should have reactants: aryl halide (e.g., bromobenzene) and acyl chloride (e.g., acetyl chloride). The first template uses aryl bromide and something like CC[O:3]CC (maybe acyl chloride? Not). The second uses aryl chloride and a carboxylate (maybe not). The third uses aryl bromide and nitrile.

Thus first seems closest: aryl bromide + something with O (maybe acyl chloride). The reactant CC[O:3]CC is maybe a carbonyl with O? Actually CC[O:3]CC is butanol? Not.

But maybe the template is generic and includes any acyl source.

We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that reproduces the reaction. So we can pick the first entry's mapped_rxn and template_id = 23352.
